html:
Greetings, Agents!

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.
 
The Asgardian Super Heroes have come forth
to fight against the multitude of cosmic threats in MARVEL Future Fight!

 

The costumes of the <Herald of Thunder>, 
<Fearless Defenders>, and <Agent of Asgard> comic storylines have arrived!
Also, enjoy the original story chapters prepared by MARVEL Future Fight!

 

3 new Uniforms for Thor, Valkyrie, and Loki!
Potential Realization for 13 Asgard-related heroes!
Prepare for the new Cosmic threat 
through the Potential Awakening and Transcend Potential of Valkyrie and Heimdall!

 

Along with the addition of stories <The True S.H.I.E.L.D.> and <The Future Ends Here>,
various content improvements such as All Skill Upgrade function, 
improved Hero Chests, and an improved Information Pop-up Screen have been prepared!
Please check the details below!

 


▣ 3 New Uniforms

 

In order to fight against the threat of the coming winter,
the Heroes of Asgard have further embraced their power!
Check out the new uniforms for Thor, Loki, and Valkyrie!

 

 

* New Uniform Skills are based on Skill Level 6 stats.
* The 3 New Uniforms will be on sale during the event and will be available for purchase in the MARVEL Universe and Uniform Room after the event.

 


▣ 13 New Potential Realized Heroes
 
A total of 13 heroes, Destroyer, Thor (Jane Foster), Ulik, Fandral, Volstagg, Hogun, Hela, Angela, Scourge, Heimdall, Sif, Malekith, and Daisy Johnson will realize their Potential through the January Update. The following heroes can be upgraded to Level 70. 

 

 

 

▣ Loki Tier-3 Ultimate Skill

 

Check out the power of Loki,
the new ruler of Jotunheim and a master of trickery!

 

Do you want to know more about Tier-3? Check out the guide below!
[Go to Potential & Tier-3 Advancement Guide]

 

 

 

▣ Valkyrie & Heimdall Potential Awakening & Transcend Potential

 

A new skill and abilities can be applied to Valkyrie and Heimdall through the January Update.
Check out the new power of Valkyrie as a leader of <Fearless Defenders>
and Heimdall as a guardian of the Bifrost!

 

If you’re wondering how to awaken a character’s potential and transcend their potential, look no further! 
Check out the guide below!

[Go to Potential Awakening & Transcend Potential Guide]

 

 

 


▣ New Story <The True S.H.I.E.L.D.> <The Future Ends Here>
 
The original stories from MARVEL Future Fight!
Enjoy the new stories based on the themes of S.H.I.E.L.D. and the Ultimates.

 

1. Only the <Alternate Mode> is available for the two newly added stories.

 

 

2. The following challenges must be completed first to enter each story.

 

 

3. A fragment can be obtained as a daily reward in the <The True S.H.I.E.L.D.> and <The Future Ends Here> Alternate Mode.

 

 

 

The “Alternate Mode” rewards of the existing Story themes <Dimensional Clash> and <The All-War>
have been improved with the inclusion of Tier-3 growth materials!
<Dimensional Clash> & <The All-War> Normal Reward LV.4 Uniform EXP Chip → changed to Titan Component Pack and Essence of Dimension
<Dimensional Clash> Fragment Combine Chest components added: Essence of Dimension x250, Titan Component Pack x250
<The All-War> Fragment Combine Chest components added: Essence of Dimension x125, Titan Component Pack x125


4. Check the information below about the new Story Stage Clear Rewards & First Clear Rewards.

 

 


▣ New Season of Future Pass & Special Icon 

 

The new season of Future Pass will begin after the Update.
Various rewards and a Special Icon can be obtained through the Future Pass!

 

If you want to know more about the Future Pass, please check the guide below!
[Go to Future Pass Guide]

 

[Future Pass Reward]

 

- The Future Pass effects will apply immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.
- Legendary and Mythic Future Pass will only be available during the season the pass was purchased, so please do not forget to check the remaining event time!
- The Mythic Pass can only be purchased after purchasing the Legendary Pass.
- The Legendary and Mythic Future Pass will not be available for purchase near the end of a season, so please check the sale schedule in-game.


Also, there are Special Icons that can represent our Agents!
Collect two new icons as Future Pass Rewards and one icon from the upcoming Event Store!

 

[January Update New Special Icons]

 

  

 

▣ New Uniform Collection
 
Check out the new Uniforms of the January Update.
Don’t miss out on the extra rewards in completing the collection!

 

The obtainable reward from the Uniform Collection is displayed on the left center of the screen!

 

 

 

▣ Other Information

 

1. The hero ranks of obtainable heroes from the Free Hero Chest and the Premium Hero Chest have been improved.
- Percentage details of the Premium Hero Chest will be announced through a separate notice.

 

[1/7 6:54 a.m. (UTC+0) / 1/6 11:54 p.m. (PST) added]
Please be aware that the Chest Improvement only applies to the Store Hero draw.
We apologize for not providing enough information.

 

[1/7 10:08 a.m. (UTC+0) / 1/7 2:08 a.m. (PST) added]
The Chest Improvement will be applied to the in-game purchase relay package.
Please check the details through the following notice.
[Go to the Notice]

 

- For the Premium Hero Chest,
the following will be given for obtaining the same or lower rank hero who an Agent already has.
- 5★ Hero obtained: Biometrics or X-Gene x128
- 6★ Hero obtained: Biometrics or X-Gene x256
- Tier-2 Hero obtained: Biometrics or X-Gene x384


2. A skill can be upgraded instantly up to the maximum level.

 


3. Hero names can be searched on the Selector screen.

 

 


4. Detailed guides will be displayed for events that will end within 3 days.

 

 

5. Attack / Defense / HP Increase Buffs will be applied in Timeline Battle depending on the usage percentage of the previous season heroes.
- If the usage percentage of the previous season heroes is consistently low, the applied buff tier will increase.
- Attack / Defense / HP increase percentages become higher as the buff tier increases.

 


6. When a portrait of a hero is selected on the Epic Quest exclusive hero acquisition pop-up screen,
the screen will move to the Hero Information screen of the hero.

 

 

7. The community Update Details can instantly be accessed through an in-game Update Pop-up screen.

  

 

 

8. Agent level growth score will be applied when a Native Tier-3 hero strengthens for each step.

 

9. Remaining time until the sale period for soon to be sold uniforms will be displayed.
* Please understand that the displayed remaining time may change depending on internal circumstances.

 

10. During a Crystal Consumption Event, items can be acquired even when already exceeding the maximum amount that can be obtained.
* This only applies to the rewards that are acquired after the Update.

 

11. The skills in Marvel Universe and Preview Skill are set to be Skill Level 6.

 

12. A menu where the blur effect can be adjusted has been added in the Settings Option menu.

 


▣ Game Error Fixes
 
1. The issue where incorrect type enhancement information of a hero displayed at the Information screen of an Agent has been fixed.
2. The issue where an error pop-up message appears when exceeding certain Squad Battle scores and rewards are not given has been fixed.
3. The issue where the Inbox does not instantly refresh after obtaining a quantity limited item from a Selector item has been fixed.
 


We will return with new heroes and content fixes in the next update.
 
Thank you.
